title: Localized module colimit comparison
statement: Let Λ be a nonempty directed preorder, B a commutative ring diagram with colimit cocone κ to T, and D an additive group diagram with colimit cocone ν to the T-module M. Give D_i a B_i-module structure; transitions and ν must be semilinear for the ring transitions and κ. Let q be a prime of T. Let N be an additive group diagram equipped with additive equivalences e_i to (D_i) at the contraction of q. Assume transitions of N under e_i send x/s to D(f)(x)/B(f)(s). Let g_i be additive maps N_i to M_q sending x/s to ν_i(x)/κ_i(s). Then there is an additive equivalence e: colim N ≃ M_q with e ∘ ι_i = g_i. The colimits, localization, and primes use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Tag 02JO (1), first paragraph: localized system and its limit; Tag 037D, proof first paragraph

proof.text: The transition fraction formula and cocone identities make the g_i compatible; the fractions exhaust each localized stage.

Lift a numerator through ν and denominator through κ to a common stage. For equality lift the multiplier outside q and descend the zero cross difference via the additive colimit. Semilinearity identifies this with the stage fraction relation. Hence the underlying set comparison is bijective; addition is preserved at common stages, yielding the required additive equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedModuleColimitComparison
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module T M]
    (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (N : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
    (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of T))
    (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))
    [∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hB : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of T) κ)))
    (hD : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M) ν)))
    (hs : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (D.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (D.map f).hom x)
    (hν : ∀ i (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) (b • x) =
        (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of T) (κ.app i)) b •
          (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum T)
    (eᵢ : ∀ i, N.obj i ≃+
      LocalizedModule (q.asIdeal.comap (κ.app i).hom).primeCompl (D.obj i))
    (hm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (x : D.obj i)
      (s : (q.asIdeal.comap (κ.app i).hom).primeCompl),
      ∃ t : (q.asIdeal.comap (κ.app j).hom).primeCompl,
        (t : B.obj j) = (B.map f).hom s ∧
        eᵢ j ((N.map f).hom ((eᵢ i).symm (LocalizedModule.mk x s))) =
          LocalizedModule.mk ((D.map f).hom x) t)
    (g : ∀ i, N.obj i →+ LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M)
    (hg : ∀ i (x : D.obj i) (s : (q.asIdeal.comap (κ.app i).hom).primeCompl),
      g i ((eᵢ i).symm (LocalizedModule.mk x s)) =
        LocalizedModule.mk
          ((@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x)
          ⟨(@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of T) (κ.app i)) s, s.property⟩) :
    ∃ e : (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) ≃+
      LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M,
      ∀ i (z : N.obj i), e ((colimit.ι N i).hom z) = g i z
